latest_release.name: Cross-platform Beta Release (PC/Mac/Linux/Android/iOS/Xbox)
latest_release.body:
# THIS VERSION IS OUT OF DATE ## Please check the [rolling release](https://github.com/SlickAmogus/silent-hill-decomp/releases/tag/realtime) for the latest updates! Will be posting a "final" crossplatform beta to replace this one very soon! It also has automatic updates on mobile/web! (must use altstore/sidestore for iOS) ## Update 10/09 - Greatly improved mobile optimization! Also fixed map screen and dialogue skipping with touch controls. ## Update 10/07 - Updated mobile versions to fix the soft locks that could occur when using touch controls, including examining items (like the receipt) and the results screen. Really sorry this was bugged for so long, I thought I had already tested it. - Also added button on touch to get to the bonus options from the options menu. - Added return to main menu function and ability to change starting map on mobile - This will probably be the last time I update this post. Soon I will post the latest versions of everything under a final beta release. I'm hoping this is the end of all the mobile soft locks. ## Update 9/28 - Updated mobile versions, you can now use the alternate camera modes (TPS, OTS, and FPS) with the touch screen. There is an eye icon on screen you can press to switch. In the alternate camera modes, click and drag on the right side of the screen to look/aim. Double tap the left side to aim, and tap the right side to fire. - Also fixed an issue where you could not touch the options on the valve puzzle before split head in the otherworld school. Should also let you decline item pickups. - Also uploaded the latest PC version and mobile has received most of the same updates where relevant. Please check the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/SlickAmogus/silent-hill-decomp/blob/pc-port/pc_port/CHANGELOG.md) for more details (also on the website sh1pc.com) ## Update 9/18 - Added more QoL improvements to Android and iOS, like a visible back button on the save/load screen. Additionally, controls can now be customized ingame on PC, Android, and iOS. PC version to be released shortly, Android/iOS already available. For mobile, controls can only be edited when a controller is connected. Additionally, snow effect has been corrected on Android, iOS, and PC. PC also has blur/dream restored. Full changelog will be available on PC when the update is posted to the nightly repo. Stay tuned for more mobile updates as I will be adding the missing dream effect soon. ## Update 9/17 - Android and iOS builds have had major updates and now support mods! They will load loose files by default, and the game looks for mods in either gamedata\load or gamedata\texturemods. The easiest way to install mods is to set them up on PC through the mod manager, and after applying, copy the load and texturemods folders directly to your gamedata folder on Android. Or, if using iOS, copy your gamedata folder entirely to Silent Hill under the File Sharing section in iTunes (Drag & Drop). You can find several mods in the discord (or ask for help if you need it). - Additionally, all platforms will now have FIXED FOG rendering like in the above, no more outlines visible in the distance! Already available on iOS and Android, will be released on PC very soon. --- Hello everyone. As the game is updated through the launcher and nightly repo most of the time, I have not posted a release here in awhile. Since there have been a ton of updates in the three months since the first Beta was posted, I feel it is time to post another, with all currently available platforms included.
